title: Unbounded Knapsack
intuition: Items can be selected infinite times. State transition checks current item values again without decrementing item indexes.
recognition_signals: Unlimited item choice supply (e.g. coin change denominations)
step_by_step_strategy: State: dp[w] is max value with weight limit w.
Transition: dp[w] = max(dp[w], val[i] + dp[w-wt[i]]) for each item i.
common_mistakes: Applying 0/1 knapsack loop constraints (needs forward inner loop in bottom-up)
content: Items can be selected infinite times. State transition checks current item values again without decrementing item indexes.
